text: My advocate received KES 1.2 million compensation from the insurance company in January on my behalf and has refused to release it. He no longer picks my calls.
The advocate failed to attend three hearings in my employment case and the court dismissed it for want of prosecution. I only learnt about it from the court registry.
I paid for a land transfer in 2023. Two years later the transfer has still not been registered and the advocate keeps saying it is at the lands office.
We agreed a fee of KES 60,000 for drafting a sale agreement. The advocate is now demanding KES 250,000 and is holding my original title deed until I pay.
I found out that the advocate representing me against a company is also the company secretary's lawyer in another matter with the same company.
When I went to the office to ask about my file, the advocate shouted at me in front of other clients, called me names and threatened to throw my documents away.
My elderly mother is being evicted next week because the advocate never filed the objection to the succession petition as he promised. Please help urgently.
The advocate sold my plot to a third party using a power of attorney I had revoked and has kept the purchase price of KES 3 million.
I want to complain that my neighbour's fence is on my land. I do not have an advocate yet.
The advocate charged me twice for the same court attendance and refuses to give me a fee note or receipts for the money I paid.
Wakili wangu alipokea fidia ya ajali kutoka kampuni ya bima mwezi wa tatu lakini amekataa kunipa pesa hizo. Simu zangu hazipokei.
Wakili hakuhudhuria mahakamani mara tatu na kesi yangu ya kazi ikatupiliwa mbali. Sikuambiwa chochote.
Nilimlipa wakili mwaka juzi ili ahamishe shamba kwa jina langu. Hadi leo uhamisho haujafanyika na kila mara anasema ni ofisi ya ardhi.
Tulikubaliana ada ya shilingi elfu hamsini lakini sasa wakili anadai laki tatu na amezuia hati yangu ya shamba hadi nilipe.
Wakili anayenitetea dhidi ya kampuni pia ni wakili wa kampuni hiyo hiyo katika kesi nyingine. Naona kuna mgongano wa maslahi.
Nilipoenda ofisini kuuliza kuhusu faili langu, wakili alinifokea mbele ya wateja wengine na kunitusi.
Mama yangu mzee atafukuzwa nyumbani wiki ijayo kwa sababu wakili hakuwasilisha pingamizi la mirathi kama alivyoahidi. Tafadhali saidieni haraka.
Mirathi ya marehemu baba yetu imechukua miaka minne bila maendeleo. Wakili haelezi familia kinachoendelea.
Nataka kulalamika kuhusu jirani yangu aliyejenga ukuta kwenye shamba langu. Sina wakili bado.
Wakili aliuza nyumba yangu na amebaki na pesa zote za mauzo, shilingi milioni mbili, bila kunipa hata senti.
Huyu lawyer alichukua doo yangu ya compensation, kama 800k, na sasa ameniblock kwa simu. Hii ni wizi bana.
Case yangu ya kazi ilitupwa kwa sababu wakili hakuenda court mara tatu. Nimepoteza kila kitu juu yake.
Nililipa wakili for title transfer since last year na bado iko pending. Kila time anasema lands office ndio wanachelewesha.
Tuliagree 40k lakini sasa anaitisha 200k na ameshikilia title deed yangu mpaka nilipe. Hii si sawa kabisa.
Lawyer wangu ni pia lawyer wa ile company niko na case nayo. How can he represent both sides?
Nilienda ofisi kuuliza progress na wakili akaanza kunitusi na kunitishia eti atadrop case yangu.
Tunafaa kuhama kwa nyumba Monday next week juu wakili alisahau kufile objection. Mama ni mgonjwa, please saidieni urgently.
Wakili ameshika pesa ya shamba tuliuza, around 1.5M, for six months sasa. Anasema bank ndio iko na issue.
Nataka tu kujua kama naweza kushtaki landlord wangu juu ya deposit. Sijawahi kuwa na wakili.
Amenicharge mara mbili for the same court appearance na hataki kunipea receipt ama fee note yoyote.
